captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a pair of 8x42 roof-prism hunting binoculars. It features two olive-green barrels connected by a central hinge mechanism, with black cylindrical eyepieces and objective lens housings. A large, black, rubber-textured center focus knob is mounted on a central bridge. The two main barrels pivot around the central hinge axis, while the focus knob rotates independently on a revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a pair of roof-prism hunting binoculars in CadQuery. The model should include two olive-green optical barrels connected by a central hinge, black cylindrical eyepieces, and a large black central focus knob. Implement a revolute joint for the focus knob and a pivot joint for the barrels.
captions.factory: The script defines an ArticulatedObject containing several parts. The central bridge and hinge act as the base frame. Cylindrical primitives are used to model the eyepieces and objective lens housings, while extruded profiles or boxes form the main tapered barrels. A cylinder represents the large center focus knob, which is articulated via a revolute joint. The two main barrels are attached to the central hinge using rotational joints to simulate interpupillary distance adjustment.
